title: Djoser's seven-year famine
summary: CFAH AP-49: the seven-year famine of Djoser (and the death of Uenephes), 2001–1994 BC; CFAH-6 ties it to Terah's famine and the time of Abraham's birth.
description: CFAH-6 Argument 4 §2 links this famine to a famine in Terah's time around Abraham's birth (1996 BC in CFAH-1 Table 1). Scripture records no famine at Abraham's birth; the link is CFAH's synchronism.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 6: The Old and Middle Kingdoms of Egypt," ARJ 18 (2025): 13–60, Argument 2, Table 1 "Anchor Points for early Egyptian history" #49; Argument 2 §A "Djoser's Famine culminated with the death of Uenephes: 2001–1994 BC"; Argument 4 §2 "Terah's Famine and Abraham's Birth"

chronologies.note: Jones (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament, 2002) gives no date for this extra-biblical event.
No matching entry found in Ussher's Annals.
